Per store-day average revenue of the 6 preceding days excluding the current day, using the window frame `rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding`. Compares today's revenue against this peer average to flag anomalies.

The product from each customer's earliest order, found using a correlated subquery that matches on customer_id and minimum order date.
Days where a store had no orders, detected by cross joining the date spine with locations and identifying gaps in the time series.
Each customer's last 5 orders with full details, retrieved efficiently using a LATERAL join.

7-day moving median revenue per store, computed via a LATERAL subquery with percentile_cont since standard window functions do not support median.
Multi-domain aggregation combining multiple FILTER conditions in a single scan of the orders table, avoiding multiple passes and subqueries.
Employee org chart built with a recursive CTE, deriving manager relationships from department and tenure data in dim_employees.
Products with zero waste events, identified using NOT EXISTS against fct_waste_events. Useful for finding products with perfect inventory management or high sell-through rates.
Recursive tree of referrer-to-referee relationships from int_referral_chain, tracking the full chain from root referrers through all levels.
Multi-dimensional revenue analysis across store, product, and month using GROUPING SETS with the grouping() function to identify aggregation levels.
Running count of distinct customers over time, using dense_rank() to work around the lack of COUNT(DISTINCT) support in window functions.

Store pairs that share customers, built via self-join on stg_orders. Computes Jaccard similarity (shared/union) and overlap coefficient as affinity scores for cannibalization and cross-promotion analysis.
